name: Achilles Tendinopathy
definition: Load-related pain and dysfunction of the Achilles tendon, commonly affecting the midportion or insertion.

typical: Posterior heel/tendon pain with running or walking

redFlags.item: Sudden snap or loss of plantar-flexion power suggesting rupture

investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI is useful when rupture, atypical lesion or surgical planning is suspected.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may show insertional calcification or other bony pathology.

green: Activity/load modification rather than complete rest
amber: Injection around the tendon requires caution; intratendinous corticosteroid is generally avoided because of rupture risk.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Snayu/Kandara-related Vata phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Load-related pain and dysfunction of the Achilles tendon, commonly affecting the midportion or insertion.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
